title: Sign in to npm so I can publish the CLI package
summary: Sign in to npm in a terminal, then tap Done. Defer if I should finish the changelog first
body:
Run this in any terminal, then tap Done:

```bash
npm login
```

Package: `@gentbox/cli`

steps.text: Open a terminal in any folder
Sign in to npm with the publishing account
steps.detail:
```bash
npm login
```

Use the account that owns the `@gentbox` scope.

steps.text: Check that the profile shows the publishing account
